text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Raaargh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I'm giving it my all—right here, right now!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno and Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At the front—it's Mejiro Ardan! Mejiro
Ardan is in
first place!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Aaand first to pass the finish line is
Mejiro Ardan!
The daughter of the
prestigious Mejiro family has
claimed the
first crown in magnificent fashion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! That's Mejiro Ramonu's little
sister,
right? I guess excellence runs in
the family after
all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, I kinda wanna rewatch
the race
where Ramonu won her first
tiara...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(My heart has never raced so fast
before... but it's
different from the jittery
feelings I experienced
during my debut
race.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(It's as though the fire burning within me
has
grown in intensity... It has engulfed
my heart!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(The sheer drive that emanated from
Yaeno and
Chiyono O during the race
remains so vivid I can
feel it...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I mustn't be complacent with this victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head out to greet Mejiro Ardan after
her
spectacular victory...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was able to display everything I
am in this
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Although the race is long over, a
renewed vigor
still swirls inside me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's a very... pleasant feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. Truly, I could never
have
done it without you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wish to ride the momentum from this
victory all
the way to the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Until then... I ask that you continue to
provide me
with your strict guidance and
wholehearted
support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined to help her continue this hot
streak, I
refocus on our next goal, the
Aoba Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was in perfect form today. There was
no way I
could've run any better.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But Ardan bested me all the same...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Argh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Things will not play out this way at the
Japanese
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Next time... I will prevail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: AAARRRGH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I knew she would be, but... Ardan really
is a
fantastic racer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And I know she'll put on an even better

performance at the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But still...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to be more like my role model... I
want to
catch up to her...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I made a vow... to win the
race she
yearns for!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't stay defeated. I won't wallow in
self-pity!
And I definitely won't stand
about crying!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Next time... I'll be the winner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With each of the three racers harboring
their own
aspirations, the Japanese
Derby draws ever
closer...
